name: Uchiyomi
subtitle: Your manga library, available offline.
localizedDescription: A native iPhone and iPad client for your own compatible Uchiyomi server, with adaptive native navigation. Requires a matching protocol-2 server/frontend (v0.107.0 or newer compatible build); protocol-1 servers are unsupported. Connect over HTTPS, sign in, and download chapters for offline reading. This beta is distributed through AltStore Classic. Exact-build device and update acceptance remains in progress.
